description: I'm Eugene Sawyer. After more than 30 years walking through other people's houses for a living, I started this channel to cut through the guesswork and the sales pitch. I'll show you the cheap problems hiding in plain sight that cost almost nothing to fix, and give you an honest breakdown of what's actually worth paying a professional for. Whether you're buying your first home, looking after the one you have, or just curious what's behind your own walls, there's something here for you.
